podcast.title: Patrick Pentland's Pre-Sloan Band
podcast.body: Happy Co. was a band in which Patrick Pentland played prior to joining Sloan. Chris Murphy was aware of Pentland's skills from this band, leading to his recruitment as a guitarist and singer for Sloan. "But we knew that he was in a band called Happy Co."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Sloan In Their Own Words: Part 1
